connection_method.key_comment: Specify iam to use IAM credentials for Redshift connections. Put tcp in case you want to use a tcp tunnel.

is_serverless.key_comment: Specify true if Redshift is serverless, or false if it is not (means, it is a Redshift-cluster).

cluster_identifier.key_comment: Specify the Redshift cluster identifier, which is the same as the cluster name. This is required only if is_serverless is set to false and connection_method is iam.

workgroup_name.key_comment: Specify the workgroup name by Redshift-Serverless. This is used only if is_serverless is set to true and connection_method is iam.

database_password.key_comment: [Optional] Specify the database user password. This is used only if connection_method is tcp.

database_host.key_comment: [Optional] Specify the database hostname or IP address. This is used only if connection_method is tcp.

database_port.key_comment: [Optional] Specify the database port. This is used only if connection_method is tcp.

bucket_name.key_comment: Specify the bucket name without the prefix (s3:// for AWS). Used for staging data during operations.

bucket_pipeline_prefix.key_comment:
[Optional] It defines the path prefix to your objects in the bucket. Don't use here the bucket name. Use a forward slash (/) to separate folders. 
By default, the string petaly/{pipeline_name} will be added as the prefix. The pattern {pipeline_name} will be automatically replaced with the pipeline name during runtime. 
If not needed, you can remove it manually after the pipeline is created.
